content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MCL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.mahanadicoal.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the MCL Revenue Inspector / Amin posts is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Certificate of Competency for Revenue Inspector / Amin jobs from a Government Recognized Institute or a Work Experience Certificate from the State Government, along with a minimum of 20 years of experience in revenue-related works.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MCL Revenue Inspector / Amin posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 69 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this MCL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies, with 4 posts for Revenue Inspector and 3 posts for Amin.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Revenue Inspector is ₹ 20,000.00 per month, and for Amin, it is ₹ 15,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for MCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the MCL Revenue Inspector / Amin posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Personal Interview, Document Verification, and the finalization of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL) at http://www.mahanadicoal.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual, meaning they are offered on a temporary basis.
